reviews.title: Just Try It
reviews.text: This is so simple, it's perfect. You don't need Apple's fitness tracker on sucking up your battery, it just counts steps on your home screen in a non-obtrusive form, and logs them in the app forever. Tells you your average steps for the week. You don't need location on, and it just works for free. After looking for a habit tracker app like this I've realised this app being free is a total anomoly, and it should be rewarded, which is why I'm writing this review. Kudos to you guys, I love you hahaha. Keep it up, and it you make paid features, please keep the home page widget free :)

reviews.title: Doesn’t reflect Apple Health step count
reviews.text: Unlike other apps that read your Health data and display the exact same numbers, this app only uses your iPhone’s motion data to count steps, meaning any steps you take without your phone in your possession are not counted. This seems like a massive oversight and so disappointing for such a promising app!
